rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I designated by the AMA or the American Academy of Family Physicians (AAFP); up to 20 hours for teaching/lecturing/precepting with documentation
rules.alternatives: With 2 hours of Category I nutrition CME: ABMS member board certification/recertification during the reporting period, or participation in ABMS maintenance of certification/continuing certification, or at least 12 months of ACGME-approved postgraduate training or fellowship in the reporting period.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial licensees complete the 3-hour Board-approved controlled substance prescribing course within one year of initial licensure (waivable if they do not prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances).
rules.audit_note: Certification of completion on the biennial renewal application; Board may audit, documents due within 30 days of written request; keep records 6 years.

topics.who: Physicians who prescribed, administered or dispensed any controlled substance under a WV license in the reporting period: Board-approved Risk Assessment and Responsible Prescribing / Drug Diversion and Best Practice Prescribing course, every reporting period (counts toward the 50); new licensees within 1 year of initial licensure

rules.notes: At least 30 of the 50 hours in the physician's specialty. Nutrition: 2 h each renewal (HB 4951, emergency rule eff. 08-11-2026), no topic code. Reporting period = 2 years before the renewal deadline; the 2026 renewal ended June 30, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code of State Rules 11CSR6 (§§11-6-3, 11-6-4); W. Va. Code §§30-1-7a, 30-3-7

rules.accepted_credit_types: AOA approved CME, at least 50% Category 1 (or CME hours in standard heart saver courses)
rules.alternatives: Licensees in a clinical residency program for more than 9 months of the licensing period may submit verification of participation instead of CME documentation.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Within one year of initial licensure: 3 hours of a Board-approved course on Risk Assessment and Responsible Prescribing of Controlled Substances (waived for non-prescribers); may count toward the biennial hours.

topics.who: Newly licensed osteopathic physicians who prescribe, administer or dispense controlled substances; within one year of initial licensure

rules.notes: Separate board: West Virginia Board of Osteopathic Medicine (wvbdosteo.org). License valid 2 years, renewed by June 30 of the second year; CME documentation is part of the renewal application. 2 of the 32 hours on nutrition (emergency rule eff. 08-18-2026) – topic not in our list.
rules.legal_basis: W. Va. Code of State Rules 24CSR1 (§§24-1-4.9, 4.10, 15.2.7); W. Va. Code §30-14-10
